stem: Which statement best identifies why students would observe the root tip of an onion to see the stages of mitosis?

options.label: A
options.text: The tip of the root is where the plant is doing the most growing.

options.label: B
options.text: The tip of the root is where photosynthesis is taking place.

options.label: C
options.text: The tip of the root is where the most water is being absorbed.

options.label: D
options.text: The tip of the root is where sexual reproduction is occurring.

visual_elements: black and white microscope image of onion root tip cells showing many cells in various stages of division
